# Learning Objectives

::: {.callout-important icon="false"}
## At the end of the workshop, participants will be able to:

-   **Understand** the **Data Science pipeline.**

-   Gain **hands-on experience** with R, RStudio, the `{tidyverse}` and R Markdown to perform the Data scientist's tasks:

    -   Import, handle and visualize data

    -   Produce automated and reproducible reports with R Markdown files
:::

# AGENDA

## Thursday

```{r}
agenda_thursday <- tribble(
  ~Time, ~Topic,
  "08:30 - 08:50", "Renku set-up & Prework",
  "08:50 - 09:00", "Welcome",
  "09:00 - 09:35", "Introduction to R",
  "09:35 - 10:00", "Working with R Markdown",
  "10:00 - 10:45", "Importing data with R + Exercise 1",
  "10:45 - 11:00", "Break",
  "11:00 - 11:15", "Exercise 1: Walkthrough",
  "11:15 - 12:15", "Data wrangling (Part 1) + Exercises 2-3",
  "12:15 - 12:30", "Exercises 2-3: Walkthrough"
)

agenda_thursday %>% 
  kable()

```

## Friday 

```{r}
agenda_friday <- tribble(
  ~Time, ~Topic,
  "08:30 - 08:45", "Recap",
  "08:45 - 10:00", "Data wrangling (Part 2) + Exercises 4-5",
  "10:00 - 10:15", "Exercises 4-5: Walkthrough",
  "10:15 - 10:30", "Break",
  "10:30 - 11:45", "Data visualisation + Exercise 6",
  "11:45 - 12:00", "Exercise 6: Walkthrough",
  "12:00 - 12:15", "Wrap-up",
  "12:15 - 12:30", "Q&A Session"
)

agenda_friday %>% 
  kable()

```

## Duration

Two mornings, 08:30 - 12:30: 8 hours, including two 15-minute breaks
